note: Built into the app. Permanent albums change only through Claude, on Travis's word. Certifications that lapse show as 'trained'; license, bond and insurance that lapse show as 'being updated'.

albums.title: Who Travis is
albums.say: Travis is licensed, bonded and insured, and these are his roofing, siding and drone credentials. He can send you the full certificates before anyone goes on a roof.

items.title: Licensed by the City of Columbus
items.text: Home Improvement Contractor license for roofing, siding, windows and doors, and a General Contractor registration.

items.title: Bonded
items.text: City of Columbus contractor surety bond.

items.title: Insured
items.text: General liability insurance for The Roof Champion of Columbus.

items.title: Workers' comp
items.text: Ohio Bureau of Workers' Compensation coverage.

items.title: Drone proficiency evaluation (BPERP)
items.text: Airborne Public Safety Association, using national drone test methods (NIST).

items.title: Thermography trained
items.text: Level 1 drone infrared thermography course through Clemson University.
